basics.name: João Pedro Moreira Campos de Lima
basics.label: Software Engineer | Full Stack | Java/Spring Boot, Python/FastAPI, Node.js, React | REST APIs, Microservices | Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD

Works from architecture through delivery, automating processes, modernizing legacy systems, and building secure, scalable integrations with Java/Spring Boot, Python/FastAPI, Node.js, and React.

work.name: Laboratory of Telematics, Accessibility and Educational Projects (LTAP) - IFCE
work.summary: Contributed to the development of an institutional PaaS that centralizes project, environment, and deployment management, integrated with GitHub and Coolify.
highlights: Architected the institutional PaaS with TypeScript, Bun, Elysia, and React, establishing boundaries across management, infrastructure, and publication.
Modeled lifecycles for 3 environments, development, staging, and production, with configuration inheritance in Prisma and PostgreSQL.
Integrated GitHub and Coolify, incorporating application and database provisioning and deployments into the project-management workflow.
Established project-level access controls, including authentication, authorization, invitations, and operational traceability, to govern platform operations.

work.name: Computer Vision and Engineering Center (NUVEN) - IFCE
work.position: Backend Developer focused on Data (Python, FastAPI)
work.summary: Contributed to the development of an analytics platform that turns social-media data into intelligence and decision support.
highlights: Architected ETL pipelines, unifying ingestion and processing for data from 3 social networks in a single analytical base.
Designed an event-driven Kafka platform, decoupling the services in the data flow.
Automated content classification and virality prediction, scaling analytical prioritization beyond manual triage.
Converted thousands of records per cycle into actionable dashboards, queries, and KPIs for 2 multidisciplinary teams.

work.name: Movias Solutions - UECE
work.position: Backend Developer focused on Data (Python, FastAPI)

highlights: Architected Python/FastAPI microservices, isolating ingestion, processing, and prediction domains.
Structured reusable components to support independent evolution of services and data-pipeline stages.
Industrialized previously manual segmentation with an AI pipeline based on Scikit-Learn, classification, and K-Means.
Standardized platform access through an API gateway, reducing integration complexity for consumers.

work.name: LabVicia - IFCE
work.position: Full Stack Developer (Java, Spring Boot, Angular)
work.summary: Contributed to the evolution of Integra-MEC, SETEC/MEC's administrative system, with a focus on security, business rules, and internal workflows.
highlights: Structured Integra-MEC's identity and access layer with Keycloak, defining permissions for platform user profiles.
Led full-stack delivery with Java, Spring Boot, Angular, and TypeScript, connecting business rules and UI in critical administrative workflows.
Designed REST APIs with filtering, pagination, and reporting to support administrative workflows.
Restructured document generation with JasperReports and evolved legacy rules, strengthening operational continuity and mitigating regressions.

work.name: Software Development Center (NDS) - IFCE
work.summary: Contributed to the evolution of internal systems built with C#/.NET, REST APIs, and a modular-monolith architecture.
highlights: Led the migration of a legacy system to a new C#/.NET API, preserving business rules and reducing transition risk.
Restructured the domain with CQRS, decoupling commands and queries to accelerate product evolution.
Increased delivery predictability through unit tests and code reviews.
Drove technical alignment across frontend, DevOps, QA, and design to ensure consistent integrations and delivery.
